mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.ec_code AS ecCode, e.ec_l1 AS ecL1, e.ec_l2 AS ecL2, e.pdd_cat_id AS pddCatId, e.pdd_cat_path AS pddCatPath, e.tb_cat_id AS tbCatId, e.tb_cat_path AS tbCatPath, e.dy_cat_id AS dyCatId, e.dy_cat_path AS dyCatPath, e.order_num AS orderNum, e.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ec_product p WHERE p.ec_category_id = e.id) AS productCount FROM ec_category e ORDER BY e.order_num
